# Collapse spaces

## Goal

`collapseSpaces` should collapse runs of spaces (` `) within a line down to a
single space, instead of being a no-op stub.

## Approach

Replace runs of the space character with a single space, using a global
regex. Leave other whitespace (tabs, newlines) untouched, since this function
is only responsible for spaces.

## DoD

- [ ] `collapseSpaces` collapses runs of spaces to one
- [ ] a test covers a multi-space input
- [ ] the existing tests still pass
- [ ] no behaviour change for input with no repeated spaces
- [ ] CI is green on the pull request (external gate; merge is blocked until
      this passes on the PR itself — not satisfied by local test runs)
